metadata.title: A smooth, environment-resolved error field
metadata.deck: A fail-closed record of the article figures, cited prior art, and the limits of the current review state.

summary.claim: The article reports that a coordination-resolved error field predicts a held-out surface-energy observable for fcc metals and can be applied as a run-time correction.
summary.scope: Article-level record for the reported fcc-metal study; this pack does not independently reproduce the internal calculations or Lean proofs.
limitations: The reported correlations, confidence interval, permutation result, correction accuracy, and run-time overhead remain needs-verification in this pack.
The cited peer-reviewed source supports systematic uMLIP softening, not the article's internal blind-prediction or correction results.
The stated boundary is limited to the article's fcc first-shell environments.
summary.lead: This pack preserves the published article's three scientific figures without upgrading internally reported results into independently verified facts.

findings.text: Peer-reviewed literature documents systematic softening in universal machine-learning interatomic potentials away from equilibrium.

findings.label: Article report
findings.text: The blind-prediction and run-time-correction values are carried as reported results and remain needs-verification here.

findings.label: Boundary
findings.text: No claim is made beyond the fcc first-shell scope described by the article.

summary.verdictBody: Repository-local figures are byte-pinned below. Their integrity does not by itself verify the scientific claims encoded in them.

methodology.description: Carry the article's selected figures into an offline dossier, pin their repository bytes, distinguish external prior art from internal results, and retain explicit uncertainty labels.
steps: Select the three scientific figures named in the published article.
Compute SHA-256 over each repository-local figure byte stream.
Map only independently supported context to the peer-reviewed bibliography.
Leave internal result figures without external source IDs and label their claims needs-verification.
